input.quote: Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "non-solicitation", "recruit", "hire", "induce ... to leave" and "personnel", plus full review of the General (§ 30), Customer Responsibilities (§ 12) and Confidentiality (§ 16) sections, found no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant binding Customer anywhere in the Agreement. To the contrary, § 12.3 expressly confirms Customer is not restricted from hiring any person who responds to general recruitment and has made no no-hire commitment. This sits at our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is needed; § 12.4's non-compete-style restriction runs against Vendor and benefits us.
